44933 Fern Avenue, Lancaster, CA 93534
Chairman David Vierra, Commissioner Mark Brown;
Commissioner Sheldon Carter; Commissioner Jeff Little;
Commissioner Lee Smith, Commissioner Angela Underwood-Jacobs
Commissioner Christy Valaskantjis
LANCASTER CRIMINAL JUSTICE COMMISSION
AGENDA
Wednesday
July 10, 2013
10:00 a.m.
Council Chambers - Lancaster City Hall
Posted by 05:00 p.m. on July 3, 2013
at the entrance to the Lancaster City Hall Council Chambers
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
Commission Members: Brown, Chelette, Pickens, Smith, Valaskantjis; Vice-Chairman Fuller; Chairman Vierra
INVOCATION
Assistant Pastor Matt Bowler, Lancaster Baptist Church
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
1.
Presentation from Antelope Valley Alcohol Prevention Coalition (AVAPC)
2.
Antelope Valley Community Youth Court Update
PUBLIC BUSINESS FROM THE FLOOR - AGENDIZED ITEMS
Citizens who would like to address the Criminal Justice Commission on any agendized item may do so when the item is being considered by the Commission. Please complete a speaker card and identify the agenda item you would like to discuss. Individual speakers are limited to three (3) minutes each.
CONSENT CALENDAR
CC 1. Approval of Minutes - June 12, 2013
COMMISSION/ STAFF PRESENTATIONS, UPDATES, REPORTS
1.
Monthly Crime Statistics Presenter: Jim Kobolt, Sr. Criminal Justice Analyst
2.
Arrest Statistics Presenter: Los Angeles County Sheriff Department
3.
California Highway Patrol Update Presenter: California Highway Patrol
4.
District Attorney Update Presenter: District Attorney's Office
5.
Business Watch Subcommittee/Public Safety Update Presenter: Lee D'Errico
PUBLIC BUSINESS FROM THE FLOOR - NON-AGENDIZED ITEMS
This portion of the agenda allows an individual the opportunity to address the Criminal Justice Commission on any item NOT ON THE AGENDA. State law prohibits the Commission from taking action on items not on the agenda and your matter will be referred to staff. Individual speakers are limited to three (3) minutes each.
COMMISSIONER COMMENTS
ADJOURNMENT
Next Regular Meeting:
Wednesday, August 14, 2013 - 10:00 a.m.
LANCASTER CRIMINAL JUSTICE COMMISSION AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, JULY 10, 2013

AGENDA ADDENDUM INFORMATION
On occasion items may be added after the agenda has been mailed to subscribers. Copies of the agenda addendum item will be available at the City Clerk Department and are posted with the agenda on the windows of the City Council Chambers. For more information, please call the City Clerk Department at (661) 723-6020.
All documents available for public review are on file with the City Clerk Department.
